capabilities: add a customizable CSS class to tags in search results
hide tags from search results via a settings toggle
configure the CSS class name in settings
extras: The README notes the plugin was authored with assistance from ChatGPT, with code reviewed and adapted by the author, and carries an unreviewed-by-staff notice.
motivation: The author built it to declutter search results when using tags to categorize notes' headings.
problem: Search results show every tag on a matched line, making long tagged headings cluttered and hard to read.
summary: Search-result decorator that adds a CSS class to tags in search results and can hide them for a cleaner display.
